messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]

    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- billing-api can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-24]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-04-22, after Team Atlas kept it until then. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- The webhooks service belongs to Team Atlas as of 2025-09-09, after Ember handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service belongs to team Ember as of 2025-04-11. [decision; valid 2025-04-11 to 2025-09-09; recorded by handover/2025-04-11-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-16]
- The webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2]

Question: Which team owned webhooks before Boreal?
